F1.anchors: p3 equations2,6-8; p14 equations29-31; p15-16 equations33-38; p4 Theorem2
F1.hypotheses: Read exogeneity/monotonicity p13 and invariant G requirement. Randomized uniform-U potential correctness with thresholds .8/.2 realizes a=.2,b=.8 without defiers. Domain nuisance can change masses while representation ignores it, retaining domain invariance.
F1.calculation: 1-PS=a/b=.25 versus a-b=-.6. Since log(x)-x is increasing on(0,1], a/b<=exp(a-b) is valid for a<=b, but exp(a-b-2)=.07427 fails. Pairs(.01,.2),(.4,.9) reverse surrogate and ratio order. Binary shifted example d=d'=0,e=0,e'=1 gives -1>-1.8. With .2 unknown mass and equal intervention errors there, -0.8>-1.44 using density ratio on source support. Fresh exact independent voter enumeration reproduced (3/4,3/8,9/16) and(1,1/2,1), hence -1/4>-1/2 in same-domain multiclass case.
F1.counterevidence: Weaker exponential surrogate upper bound exists; support partition valid when one risk consistently defined. Treating full open-set divergence as infinite gives a vacuous bound rather than rescuing useful finite guarantee.
F1.severity_remedy: Major: central susceptibility identity, signed transfer bound and multiclass Gibbs decomposition fail. Need redefine surrogate and replace transfer proof; empirical accuracy not refuted.

F2.anchors: p4-5 Corollary1 equations13-14; p16-17 equations40-43, p17 image actually viewed
F2.calculation: With one true label and constant wrong classifier both expected error differences and empirical correctness differences vanish for every sample. Gaussian standard deviations2,1 yield -log2<0, so asserted every-parameter bound fails with probability1. Monotonicity equality and domain-independent representations allowed. KL(N01||N04)=log2+1/8-1/2=.318147; reverse= -log2+2-1/2=.806853. Negative first cannot equal positive second.
F2.counterevidence: A parameter-independent divergent prior term can be discarded for an optimization heuristic, not a finite PAC-Bayes guarantee. Risk sign mismatch does not affect zero-gap counterexample.
F2.severity_remedy: Major central empirical-to-population theorem needs proper prior, valid signed concentration and sample/confidence terms.

F3.anchors: p5 equations15-16 and p17 equations44-47; p13 assumptions
F3.calculation: For balanced independent E,Z, C=Z xor E,Y=Z: C independent E but knowing C leaves Y determined by E, hence I(Y;E|C)=1 bit. Same-label paired Cs=Z,Ct=1-Z has maximal1bit shared information. Under literal fixed-class/fixed-data centroid definition, source centroid constant makes MI zero for every candidate and the optimization is vacuous. Responders.6,defiers.1,never.3 yield positive average .5 yet10% violations; true PS=.6/.9=2/3 versus(.6-.1)/.9=5/9.
F3.counterevidence: Cosine alignment may prefer a non-permuted solution; counterexample targets claimed equivalence, not assertion that implementation must learn permutation. Mean objective alone cannot enforce pointwise monotonicity.
F3.severity_remedy: Major because these objectives are asserted to satisfy causal identification assumptions. Need joint-law/identifiability conditions or weaker heuristic wording.
